subject: Hedgehog
observations: Recognizable hedgehog with two eyes, ears and feet; a leaf plausibly occludes one forelimb.
Brown spines, tan face/body, turquoise scarf, large yellow leaf, red apple, purple mushroom cap, orange stalk and green vegetation supply substantial contrasting colors.
Separate scarf ends, paired feet/ears and green plants repeat colors; large props improve engagement beyond the old brown animal/apple. Leaf veins and gloss do not count as extra regions.
suggestions: Keep broad shapes; suppress gloss slivers, thin leaf veins and scarf-fringe microregions in processing.
scope: Source visual engagement/anatomy/cleanliness gate for ages 4+, judged against user-approved 35/37. Source PASS is not playable-output approval.
